content.text:
## Files changed

1. **`src/index.css`** — main layout/responsive updates  
2. **`index.html`** — viewport meta (`interactive-widget=resizes-content` for mobile keyboard)

`Layout.tsx` unchanged (structure already correct).

---

## Layout approach

**Viewport chain** — `html`, `body`, and `#root` are `width: 100%`, `height: 100%`, `min-height: 100dvh` (with `100vh` fallback), no margins, `overflow-x: hidden`.

**App shell** — `.app-shell` spans the full window (`width: 100%`, `max-height: 100dvh`, `overflow: hidden`). Header and main use `max-width: 30rem` and `margin-inline: auto` for readability on desktop; the shell and nav bar stay full width.

**Scrolling** — `.app-main` uses `flex: 1`, `min-height: 0`, and `overflow-y: auto` so only the main area scrolls; the header stays put.

**Bottom nav** — `position: fixed` with `left: 0` / `right: 0` / `width: 100%` (no centered `max-width: 480px`). Grid uses `minmax(0, 1fr)` to avoid horizontal overflow; safe-area padding for notched devices; `:has()` adjusts columns when admin adds a 7th link.

**Standalone pages** — Login, auth loading, and Admin (`#root > .page`) fill the viewport with the same flex/`100dvh` pattern.

**PWA** — manifest/service worker untouched; `viewport-fit=cover` and theme meta kept.

---

## Mental test (mobile / tablet / desktop)

| Breakpoint | Behavior |
|------------|----------|
| Narrow mobile | 3-column nav grid; labels ellipsis; no horizontal page scroll |
| ≥400px | 6-column nav; content centered up to 30rem |
| Wide desktop | Full-width shell + nav; content column centered |
| Admin (7 nav items) | Auto-fit grid via `:has(.nav-link:nth-child(7))` |
